pma:database.pma:table: CREATE TABLE `spare_parts` ( `spare_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `part_code` varchar(150) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Spare parts code unique', `part_hsn` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL, `part_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, `part_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'type1', `part_billing_price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL, `part_mrp` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Spare part maximum retail price', `part_qty` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `safety_stock_acat` int(11) NOT NULL, `safety_stock_bcat` int(11) NOT NULL, `safety_stock_ccat` int(11) NOT NULL, `part_discount` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `part_tax` float NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `part_status` varchar(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Y' COMMENT 'Y - Activated, N - Not active', `part_deleted` varchar(2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'N', `created` datetime NOT NULL, `last_update` datetime NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`spare_id`), UNIQUE KEY `part_code` (`part_code`), KEY `spare_id` (`spare_id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=10557 DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1;
